notes.title: Dedicated Server & Dungeon Lv3 Are Here! Enjoy the smoothest multiplayer ever!
notes.content:
Battle Talent has reached its [b]2nd anniversary[/b]! A huge thank you to all our players - your continuous support fuels our passion to create exciting new content and richer experiences. 
Without further ado, let's dive into what's new in this update:
[h1]New Challenges
[/h1]
Face off against the evil and powerful [b]Flame Demon[/b] along with [b]Challenge Dungeon Lv3[/b]!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/acb2584502d3c2781e0a132bda26ba07b617f489.gif[/img]

The Fire Demon brings unique mechanics that require agile responses - [b]stay focused and sharpen your battle instincts![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/498e8b3c947fab1292899a11ce1c24722b745a05.gif[/img]

Enemies in [b]Challenge Dungeon Lv3[/b] have received special enchantments, becoming stronger and deadlier - one careless move and you'll meet your end at their blades!
[b]Multiplayer now includes Dungeon Lv2 and Lv3.[/b] The Flame Demon also appears in Dungeon Lv3 and the Synced Arena, allowing you to team up and conquer evil with your friends!

[h1]New Weapon: Spellblade
[/h1]
A weapon of legend, the subject of countless tales and the yearning of warriors past and present. Embed [b]Spell Stones[/b] to rend the fabric of space, unleashing elemental magic from beyond, be it searing flame or biting frost, granting special magical effects to your sword.
If multiple [b]Spell Stones[/b] are embedded, switch between them and press [b]Trigger + A/X [/b]to combine selected spell crystal's power into existing magical rifts! Many more secret capabilities of this legendary weapon await discovery, enabling countless dynamic combos!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/826706c008aadf424eabf91af3639711c068f033.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/ecf9630c0eecf97cde30880875e8e118bde6149d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/0760cd3bd54ffd14f43c7a7d906500a8e653b90a.gif[/img]

[h1]Dedicated Servers
[/h1]To fundamentally [b]reduce multiplayer latency[/b] and improve the overall experience, multiplayer now supports [b]Dedicated Servers[/b]!
As long as you have an internet-connected PC, you can easily set up your own server and enjoy smooth co-op gameplay with friends.
All players connect directly to the server, significantly reducing latency. The host no longer bears the performance load, greatly minimizing stuttering and lag. You can even keep the server running, so you and your friends can hop in and play anytime!
You can [url=https://fonzieliu.itch.io/btds]click here[/url] to view the [b]setup guide[/b] and [b]deploy your server[/b] with ease.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/319fe2a018f0b10711dddc582cd38952cb1587dc.png[/img]

[h1]New Player Skins
[/h1]We've meticulously crafted two brand-new skins: [b]Knight of Ashes and Grim Blade![/b]
These [b]paid cosmetic[/b] skins are available for purchase or gifting in the multiplayer lobby, and can also be used in single-player mode for a more immersive experience.
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/090e20375bb40843971c72a8681ea25a03528892.gif[/img]

[h1]Important Improvements
[/h1]
[b]Demon Flame Greatsword: [/b]A massive two-handed sword dropped by the defeated Flame Demon, still infused with traces of its power. Swing it to unleash searing evil flames.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/5da6b415cb53a5118de60d7c9f25111ba4f4b8fc.gif[/img]

[b]Combat physics are now more realistic,[/b] you can block and push away enemies and their weapons. Enemies will also better gauge their distance and positioning. Stay alert and fight strategically!
Many [b]visual and audio effects[/b] have been refreshed, providing even richer feedback. Enemy modding interface and parrying tutorials have been adjusted to reduce confusion.
Performance issues such as frame drops and crashes have been addressed, aiming for a smoother gaming experience.
[b]Human enemies[/b] now come with new armor visuals, and we've refreshed a wide range of effects and sounds to make combat feel more impactful. We've also fine-tuned the [b]Mod NPC [/b]interface and parry tutorial levels to make them more intuitive and easier to navigate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/2506a26e7d1a135bd8032e2c21626de7d6ac00f4.png[/img]

This covers the key highlights of this update. Many more details await your discovery in-game, we can't wait to hear about your adventures!

[h1]Special Thanks
[/h1]
A heartfelt thank you to all [b]beta testers[/b] for their valuable contributions!
Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/battletalent]Discord channel[/url]: Sign up for beta testing, get early access, and help us improve!

notes.title: New Weapons, New Ways to Dominate! Gear Up for Battle!
notes.content:
We know you’ve been itching for new weapons, and we’ve got three fresh ones ready to shake things up! [b]Two in-game beasts and one official mod weapon[/b], each packing some seriously cool abilities. Can’t wait to see the insane combos you come up with!

We’re also always listening to community feedback ([b]if you haven’t joined yet, now’s the time![/b]). This update brings smoother hand tracking, better sound effects, improved MR performance, and some [b]key bug fixes[/b], including crash issues and object collisions when crouching. Let’s jump in!


[h2] New Weapon: [b]Spear of Return[/b] [/h2]

[b]Throw! Pierce! Recall! Detonate![/b]

Hurl the spear with [b]divine retribution[/b], its blade piercing through multiple enemies. If it strikes terrain, the impaled foes will be pinned like specimens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/610e514e358d3f91973bfa926a3eec5eacb568ef.gif[/img]


The [b]Spear of Return[/b] obeys your command—[b]summon it back instantly [/b]at any time. But this is only the beginning of the true art of slaughter. When recalled, [b]an illusory shadow [/b]lingers in place, and all remnants of these shadows become deadly bombs you’ve strategically planted!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/3bdd448845f87c46821e76683870c4c42012747e.gif[/img]
 
[h2] New Weapon: [b]Thunderbolt Wolf Claw[/b] [/h2]

Each strike charges the weapon with [b]unstable lightning energy[/b]. After multiple attacks, [b]lightning surges forth[/b], triggering [b]chain lightning[/b] that weaves a [b]deadly[/b] electric [b]web[/b] across your enemies.

When the lightning is at its peak, you can [b]launch the electrified claws[/b], transforming them into a [b]raging storm of lightning[/b] that electrifies everything in its path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/9fb7a04f09f8575067b107b30848f42f83e7e493.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/7fd62fffe25b091031b0a852faba7f4f3b9a5a26.gif[/img]

Once the claws are thrown, you can instantly reforge them, [b]triggering a shockwave[/b] that paralyzes nearby enemies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/4bd1044580fb695a6b220fd5795fb96b277572f5.gif[/img]



[h2] New Official Mod Weapon: [b]Khopeshrang[/b] [/h2]

[i](Requires download from the mod menu)[/i]

When thrown, the [b]Khopeshrang[/b] will [b]automatically return[/b] to your hand. [b]Hold to charge[/b], and upon hitting its first target, it will begin a [b]spatial teleportation slash [/b]between enemies. [b]Raise your hand and swing in midair[/b], and the [b]Khopeshrang[/b] will obey, striking down your chosen prey with deadly precision.

At any time during this sequence, you can reactivate it to have the [b]Khopeshrang[/b] [b]orbit around you[/b], creating a spinning blade barrier that repels any enemy daring to approach.


[h2] Major Improvements [/h2]

[b]Sound Enhancements:[/b] We’ve improved numerous sound effects, including most weapon and environmental audio. We’ll continue optimizing in-game audio—stay tuned!

[b]Better Item Interaction:[/b] When crouching to pick up objects or enemy corpses, your legs [b]will no longer accidentally kick them away.[/b] Now, leg collisions are ignored when crouching, making it easier to interact with objects on the ground.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/88e3f2760e7f21dc1bb0db36ed77877bf4cd8c2e.gif[/img]

[b]Weapon Tutorials:[/b] To help players master weapons more easily, you can now [b]watch weapon demo videos[/b] from both the [b]Talent Tablet[/b] and [b]Cheat Menu[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/7e842e82ee355e332844fe34f5208370c5e42a46.gif[/img]

[b]Crash Fixes:[/b] We’ve resolved several [b]crash-related issues[/b] for a smoother experience.

[b]Japanese Language Support:[/b] The game now supports Japanese, and weapon descriptions have been refined for better clarity.

[b]Hand Tracking & MR Enhancements:[/b]
- Hand movement tracking is now smoother, weapons are less likely to slip, and fist punching is supported.
- MR enemy and player body visuals have been improved, and weapons now refresh post-battle for a seamless experience.

[hr][/hr]

[h2] Special Thanks [/h2]

We are extremely grateful for the active contributions of the following [b]beta testers[/b].

Everyone is [b]welcome to join our Discord channel and sign up for testing[/b]! You’ll get early access to new versions and have a direct impact on improving the game with your feedback. [b]See you there![/b]

notes.title: Christmas Cheer with New Weapons and Better Multiplayer!
notes.content:
This winter, we’re delivering an update packed with groundbreaking features and Christmas cheer. With legendary weapons, immersive environments, and much-needed multiplayer fixes based on your feedback, there’s never been a better time to join the fray. Here’s what’s in store:

[h1]Legendary Weapons[/h1]

[h2]Excalibur[/h2]
The legendary [b]sword in stone[/b] arrives to Battle Talent with devastatingly powerful abilities for both the 'Stone' and 'Sword' components! Use the sword to slay your enemies and the stone to strike any remaining ones down into dust.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/feb669832188db065128f1d2b16a62b116b36aa9.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/62f84fb5d193f0a7f0e53b48870f127d7b1ac0b1.gif[/img]

[h2]Ancient Flying Sword[/h2]
Now decimate hordes of enemies without lifting a foot via the ancient sword that mimics your hand gestures, but that’s not all — You can [b]take to the skies[/b] by jumping on the blade and controlling it, unleashing devastating aerial combos and maneuvers while you fly through the battlefield in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/e620b5e3b5872dbfa118d8c205e03313c7bc0d5f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/7ef9e0588ab53b49dc7b1ae503e9b374105f20dc.gif[/img]

[h1]Christmas Night Has Arrived![/h1]
The [b]Sandbox Castle[/b] and [b]Multiplayer Hall of Homology[/b] have transformed into a magical [b]Christmas Night[/b] mode! Explore the festive charm under the starry skies, but watch out for the campfires—don’t let the flames catch you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/d8685f96f6ec365b364ee841dffc3df7ca8dde46.gif[/img]

[h1]Beware the Enchanted Enemies![/h1]
Get ready for a tougher challenge as some goblins, skeletons, wraiths, and warriors now wield weapons imbued with [b]mystical elemental powers[/b]! From ice and fire to lightning and gripping enchantments, these weapons bring elemental power to the battlefield.
In multiplayer, with [b]friendly fire[/b] enabled, even your teammates aren’t safe from these effects! Stay sharp—both friend and foe might bring the heat (or frost)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/85f36e5982849c311cf4f319dcab96768c5a76ff.gif[/img]

[h1]MR Mode: Features & Enhancements (Quest3) [/h1]
[h2]Hands-On Gameplay Like Never Before: [/h2]
Forget controllers! With new [b]hand tracking support[/b], you can grab objects by gripping with three fingers and use gestures like pinching your index finger and thumb to trigger actions. You can grab props in the real world while picking up weapons in the game and swing them, elevating your MR and VR gameplay to new levels of immersion! 
Please note, this is hand tracking feature, and you need to hold the props to [b]turn them into weapons[/b]. Currently, it is in the experimental stage, and only grip and trigger functions are supported. It cannot track individual fingers yet, and the tracking accuracy is still being improved. We will continue to refine it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/36efd5fe4a71c71152d9f377b2a311d0a93a220e.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/188dc7b6b7b8fb8571cad9f5bd31b9f83874f7e8.gif[/img]

[b]Mind Control Spell[/b] now supports voice recognition, allies can be controlled [b]using voice commands[/b]! Simply say commands like [b]stay, stop, idle, attack, go, follow, come, or back[/b] to seamlessly direct your NPC allies’ actions.
Additionally, with [b]ModTK optimizations[/b], you can now create [b]voice-controlled mods[/b], opening up endless possibilities for custom gameplay experiences.

notes.title: Dungeon Adventures Await! Multiplayer Mode Just Got a Major Upgrade!
notes.content:
After months of debuging and feedback collecting, we're thrilled to introduce the highly anticipated [b]Multiplayer Dungeon Exploration[/b]! This update brings the core of our captivating single-player dungeons into an exciting multiplayer experience.

[h1]Multiplayer Dungeon Exploration[/h1]

Fans of our rogue-like dungeons have long asked for a similar experience in multiplayer - and now it's here! The new [b]randomized dungeon challenges[/b] allow you to team up with friends and tackle procedurally generated obstacles, enemies, and surprises together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/d77f9c98c514df6aea2157b278056cdaadc757a4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/b9fb3aff587c16eb99c3ec7562fedb2efbabb66c.gif[/img]

This is a major upgrade from our previous multiplayer, which was limited to sandbox and arena maps. Now, you can fully immerse yourself in a cooperative dungeon crawl with your team, with [b]detailed stat tracking[/b] and a summary of your [b]group’s performance[/b] at the end of each run.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/c1050edb76a7c9cee98101a3737a4f752c7e590c.png[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer Mod Map: Spider-Tag[/h1]
Use your energy grappling hook to move swiftly across the map, but watch out—one player will be randomly selected as the hunter. Touching other players will infect them, and the round ends when everyone’s infected or time runs out. Can you outrun the hunter, or will you become part of their web?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/598155caf33944542a6e6e512bfbb89a28c2253a.gif[/img]

[h1]Multiplayer Mod Support[/h1]
We’re giving our modding community more power! This update adds support for [b]multiplayer mod maps with custom rules[/b], multiplayer mod weapons, and even mod NPCs. Build your dream battlegrounds, weapons, and enemies, then invite your friends to join in on the fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/85485adb675a63ae428bf917df15769c45acbd4a.gif[/img]

[h1]New Title System [/h1]
Show off your accomplishments in style! Players can now earn and display [b]unique titles[/b] during multiplayer matches. These titles are unlocked by achieving specific feats across different modes. Wear your title with pride and let others know who’s boss!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/080715ab082401ecbec5613bebfd026dce32fc33.gif[/img]

[h1]Mixed Reality Mode Enhancement [/h1]
We’ve added some storyline and guidance for both solo and multiplayer!  Plus, we’ve upgraded the visuals to blend even better with your real space—making everything feel way more real and immersive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/30b4d05d339f8c9515d62c6dc7b8c089d7e13120.gif[/img]

[h1]Halloween Spirit & Language Support[/h1]
We’ve brought a full [b]Halloween Vibe[/b] into the game—complete with spooky decorations and the chance to [b]fly on a broomstick[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/571eb930e91c1360cca8225cdacc2295189a268f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/3b9daca20d96632ff787b7b5d0c8fd05d9fff0a5.gif[/img]

We’re also thrilled to welcome [b]Russian[/b] and [b]Swedish[/b] players to the battlefield! Our game now supports these languages, ensuring that more warriors around the world can join in the fun. 
So grab your gear, gather your team, and jump into the action, and don’t miss out our seasonal update!

notes.title: MULTIPLAYER & Anniversary Update! Time to Battle in Style!
notes.content:
Finally! Finally!！ 

After more than three months of hard work, we are thrilled to unveil our latest major update. This time around, we've been working tirelessly to bring you incredible new content. It's also our 1st-anniversary update, and we couldn't have made it this far without the support of our amazing players. 
Let's dive in and see what we have in store for you!

[h1]Multiplayer mode[/h1]

We're thrilled to announce the arrival of the highly-anticipated MULTIPLAYER MODE, which supports [u]Cross-play[/u] across Quest and PC. And this update is completely free, no need to purchase any additional content. [u]Just a simple game update and you're all set! [/u]
You can now head to the brand-new Hall of Homology and meet up with your friends for some pre-battle pranks! You can select the battle map for your team by operating the central console. And we've also cooked up a fresh new Homology Arena where you can experience some seriously intense battles, just give it a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/8435fdc594a14f3e2874d888cc5a88347351568f.gif[/img]

In Multiplayer Mode, you can do anything that you can do in real life, and highly potential gameplay waiting for you to explore! Enchant your teammate's weapons, unleash fusion magic together with your teammates, and create any cool combos like in Anime. You can even steal potions or weapons from your friends's bags if you're the troublemaker!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/4158af387bdbd9c0147503e6b65e79a352db6696.gif[/img]

You can talk to each other using our built-in voice chat (or mute your mic). And here's the cool part - the spatial audio effects make it easy to figure out where your teammates are. It's like they're right there with you in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/d323a5955a3e2f80145d06c3da5fcc861941822a.gif[/img]

You can also inflict damage on other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/322fcd19225f849732c67b1250c4729a8d7be18c.gif[/img]

How to create your battle team? You can join anyone's room once you enter the multiplayer mode and check the room list, or use the room ID to join your friend's battle. And you can join a room at any time, even during a battle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/8b5a1d7f63f22cdd4c9eb0e66e20a17ac9c415b5.gif[/img]

Note: we support LAN Discovery, so you can experience a minimum 30ms latency if your team is on the same network.
You can also create your room as the host, where you have control over all the features, and joiners can use a cheat menu to edit the scene and spawn enemies and weapons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/af0a897ce564c7a6f6b3a60d04aee0c5b009087b.gif[/img]

If you choose to go to the sandbox, the team can use the panel to customize the battle together. We added pre-set campaign configurations in the sandbox, making it easier to start.

[h1]Mixed Reality Mode[/h1]

Guess what? You can now play multiplayer content in MR mode! Just imagine setting up your battle scene with your friends in the same display space, taking on powerful enemies together. Note: all the real-world objects in the game have their own physical collisions, making it feel even more like real mixed reality.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/d1793d7b60698d9eaac0ccfc4b3552abe5ff0035.gif[/img]

Our MR mode now supports LAN multiplayer gameplay when offline, but needs to be aligned manually. You can also play online and the Spatial Anchor feature of the Quest 3 device will automatically align the players.
We have also added other features to MR:
[list]
[*] “Only Ground" feature, can hide environmental collisions other than the ground.
[*] "Body See Through" feature, can make character body parts transparent other than the cloak and hands.
[/list]

[h1]New skills[/h1]

Using the new magic imbue system, now you can turn any weapon into an elemental weapon!! Just hold the spell close to your weapon for a short while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/03bd26a93a34bc88b8cbf66fc5989fd0e0c94396.gif[/img]

We've also given a makeover to the grasping spell. Not only a new look, but its new features can help you create super cool combos.
When targeting an enemy, you can suspend it with a big transparent hand. If not, a magical ball will be made in your hand, and can be thrown at an enemy to cause the same effect. Press the trigger at the time, you will be moved quickly to the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/f2d37e001beb67651d4ecf6fe195e11fe1849900.gif[/img]


[h1]New weapon[/h1]

If you're familiar with Chinese myths, you'll know that the Golden Cudgel is Wu Kong's weapon. This weapon can extend and retract at your will as in the story, you can use this feature to create your battle style! Ofc, as a kungfu master, staff spinning is a piece of cake.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/03f5d05182371398c101662b88aecda7bf37d04e.gif[/img]


[h1]New feature[/h1]

Now, you can create a new save data, switch the existing save files, and manage your save data on the mode selection screen.

[h1]Enhancements[/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved transition effect of dungeon rooms
[*] Enhanced the Combat Feedback and adjusted some enemy behaviors and AI to make combat more interesting and interactive
[*] Redesigned special effects for multiple weapons, scenes, and NPCs
[*] Adjusted the interface to make it easier to use, and adjusted some weapon balance
[*] Fixed some bugs, such as the effectiveness of potions
[/list]

Thanks for reading till the end! 
A huge shoutout to all the testers, players, moderators, and the entire dev team. There's still plenty of polishing to do, especially for our multiplayer mode. Feel free to join our community and let's make this game even more awesome!

[i]- Dev&Moderator team -[/i]

notes.title: October Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello guys,

This time, the update took a bit longer than expected because our development team has made significant changes to the game. We hope these changes will bring joy to all of you!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

In this update, we're introducing a brand new mode selection feature. Now, when you enter the game, you'll have the freedom to choose between three different modes: Sandbox Mode, Adventure Mode, and Challenge Mode.

- In Sandbox Mode, you can freely access any level, use any items, and make any modifications. The cheat menu will be readily available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/c0236d14e1f6bae370ab5d37910078c91922f3cb.gif[/img]

- Adventure Mode will no longer feature dungeons, allowing you to immerse yourself more seamlessly in the story's progression at the Temple of Talents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/641914bd13f939f3229737feacbf3fc345a8e6d1.gif[/img]

- Challenge Mode offers a more complete, diverse, and challenging dungeon experience. You can switch between these modes at any time, depending on your preferences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39405537/1cdc5037ef3b1dc0083f626b343b898b76681a60.gif[/img]

[h2]New Updates[/h2]

We've updated the rogue-lite elements in Challenge Mode, making dungeon adventures significantly different from before. Within the dungeons, there's now an independent economic system. We've also added new content to keep the economic system engaging and create a complete and enjoyable dungeon experience, including:

- Decomposition

After three years of development, we are excited to announce that the full version is finally released! It's been an incredible journey, starting from scratch and transforming a rough demo into a fully released game. We want to express our deepest gratitude for your support and companionship throughout these three years. Thank you for all the suggestions and encouragement that literally made the game successfully gone through more than 30 updates, completely remade all artwork, evolving from a simple single arena into a complicated roguelite dungeon game with nearly 50 levels. Although this is the release of the game, it doesn't mean our development journey ends here. We will continue working on it and update the game monthly.
